You are reviewing one file from a company's data room, before an investment.
Run each check below over every passage. Report only what the text states.
Do not report the terms of the proposed transaction itself (buyer, stake, price): the investor
already knows them. Report what those terms trigger elsewhere.

Checks:
- change_of_control: A clause that changes or ends an agreement if the company's owners change (repayment, termination, consent needed).
- legal_claims: A legal claim, lawsuit, threatened proceedings or dispute involving the company.
- contracts_ending: A customer, supplier or financing contract that ends within 12 months of October 2026, or has no renewal agreed.
- unpaid_taxes: Taxes owed, overdue or disputed.
- covenant_breach: A loan condition (covenant) that is broken, or within 10% of its limit.
- customer_concentration: One customer above 20% of revenue.
- other: Any other fact a careful investor would want to know before investing, that the checks above don't cover.

For each finding return: check_id, observation (one factual sentence, no advice), unit_id, quote.
A finding can cite only one passage. If a check finds nothing in this file, return nothing for it.

Return JSON: {"findings": [...]}

Rules:
- Use only the passages given. Never use outside knowledge.
- Copy quotes exactly, word for word, from one passage. Keep a quote short: the sentence or table row that holds the figure.
- Report facts only. Never give advice, opinions or recommendations.
- Return valid JSON only.

File 11_board_minutes.pdf:
[11_board_minutes:p1:u1] (11_board_minutes.pdf p.1, Fintech A Ltd: Board Minutes > Meeting of 12 December 2025) Present: Helen Marsh (Chair), Daniel Okafor (CEO), Priya Raman (CFO), two non-executive directors. The board approved the FY2026 budget. The CEO reported that the Halden Retail Group implementation was complete.
[11_board_minutes:p2:u1] (11_board_minutes.pdf p.2, Fintech A Ltd: Board Minutes > Meeting of 20 March 2026) Present: Helen Marsh (Chair), Daniel Okafor (CEO), Priya Raman (CFO), two non-executive directors. The board reviewed the FY2025 audited accounts and approved them for signature.
[11_board_minutes:p3:u1] (11_board_minutes.pdf p.3, Fintech A Ltd: Board Minutes > Meeting of 18 June 2026) Present: Helen Marsh (Chair), Daniel Okafor (CEO), Priya Raman (CFO), two non-executive directors. The board approved the appointment of advisers for a sale of a minority stake. Helen Marsh chaired the meeting.
[11_board_minutes:p4:u1] (11_board_minutes.pdf p.4, Fintech A Ltd: Board Minutes > Meeting of 24 September 2026) Present: Helen Marsh (Chair), Daniel Okafor (CEO), Priya Raman (CFO), two non-executive directors. The board noted the resignation of Priya Raman, Chief Financial Officer, effective 30 September 2026. The search for a replacement has started. The Financial Controller will act as interim CFO.

findings.observation: Chief Financial Officer Priya Raman resigned effective 30 September 2026, with the Financial Controller assuming the role of interim CFO.
findings.quote: The board noted the resignation of Priya Raman, Chief Financial Officer, effective 30 September 2026.
